metaTitle: How to Choose a Camping Power Bank
description: Choose a camping or backpacking power bank by daily watt-hours, USB-C output, weight and cold performance, with sizing tables for phones to laptops.
directAnswer: Add up your devices' daily watt-hours, multiply by days between recharges, add 30 percent for losses, then pick a bank that covers it with the right USB-C output. Weekend hikers usually need 10,000 to 20,000 mAh, laptop users a 100 W model.
